a.lede: Ted Lasso, which everyone thought was ending with Season 3, has just been renewed for a fifth season.
a.title: Apple confirms Ted Lasso will return for Season 5

b.lede: One of Apple's biggest shows is sticking around for at least one more season. The streamer announced today that Ted Lasso has been renewed for a fifth season on Apple TV, after what the company calls a "record-breaking season four debut." There are currently no details about the new season nor when it might debut. […]
b.title: Apple renews Ted Lasso for season 5
